hyps_field_allocation.scope: Exhaustive classification of46 fields, not an assertion that they are46 independent hypotheses or that every field type is fully unfolded.
hyps_field_allocation.coherence: All fields share one familyclass A and selection sigma. Measures/maps/spaces referenced by selP,selB,selS must be transported coherently; separate constructions cannot be substituted without an equality/compatibility theorem.
hyps_field_allocation.nonvacuity: RawSel on a possibly empty A is not sufficient. Retain hEx (MinkDiv implies ExS) and its classical MinkDiv input: ExS constructs admissible families under prescribed host requirements. Closed conditions and nRest must hold on those actual families.
hyps_field_allocation.quantifiers: Family-level constants such as cIc,c30 and decay/norm bounds must respect the source Closed operators and appear before the variables they control. Accuracy-dependent constants may be weakened only through an explicitly proved vanishing-total-loss replacement.

literature_wrapper_reachability.scope: Lexical qualified wrapper-reference graph inside this flat assembly file, including references in statements. Not a complete elaborated proof-term dependency graph.

one_host_packet_cut.quantifiers: For fixed Lambda,eD,eL,K,cHH,eK,C,epsilon>0, there exists x1 such that every x>=x1 and every frame/HostAx/subset satisfying EAtH and CoreAtH yields the scalar bound.
one_host_packet_cut.per_point_requirement: Only one such host is needed at each x; the source family bridge extracts one index. The witnesses may vary with x, while the named error constants remain fixed before x.

preferred_replacement_program.scope: Fix one primitive target character (or its conjugate). At each accuracy j use any finite positive character combination retaining that target with positive weight, fixed throughout its own cofinal whole-window sequence. Positive exponent losses tend to zero. Auxiliary characters, their weights, multiplicative constants and power-window exponents may all vary across j; no uniform positive target-weight or window-width lower bound is required.
preferred_replacement_program.packet_budget: The original packet budget (eD_j+eL_j+7)*epsilon_j -> 0 remains sufficient. A direct averaged construction may instead prove H_j(x)<=M_j*x^(1/2+delta_j) with delta_j->0 under the stated whole-window quantifiers.
preferred_replacement_program.limits: This changes the sufficient target, not the truth of any missing arithmetic/geometric estimate. The source contract retains its stronger fixed-eD/eL quantifier.
preferred_replacement_program.construction_target: Finite averaged arithmetic discrepancy and explicit finite projection/transfer errors; weighted lower estimates with actual frame penalties. See notes/one-construction-target.md and manuscript cs-finite-average, cs-weighted-lower.

new_mathematical_result.proved: The fixed-family vanishing-loss theorem remains valid. Its stronger corollary allows a different finite positive character combination at each accuracy, retaining a fixed target character or its conjugate with positive weight. Separate pole-exclusion arguments for each fixed family establish target zero-freeness right of one half as total exponent loss tends to zero.
new_mathematical_result.independent_review: global_inputs reviewed the fixed-family theorem. Root and endpoint agents independently checked the varying-family extension against positive-family residues and landau-independent, including arbitrary positive target weights, conjugates, zeta, and whole-window quantifier order; the earlier across-accuracy fixed-family necessity was corrected. The global-input agent also independently reviewed the final varying-family statement and proof and reported PASS.
new_mathematical_result.limits: Does not provide the arithmetic construction, permit the family or constants to vary freely with x/Y within a fixed accuracy stage, omit target occurrence, or allow zero target weight at an individual stage.
